title: Validate combined G03 Post candidate against published V4 and fresh V3 Phase 9
goal: Close candidate-level C2 coverage with exact five-module, 16-claim composition and scoped V3 comparison, without accepting a production bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: The candidate Profile selects exactly five reviewed G03 modules, 16 unique blocking rules/claims, current authority hashes and no baselines or undeclared capabilities.

Published V4 1.1.2 synthetic composition passes direct and dependency Post on real IFX; missing module/claim/rule, stale authority, violating and zero-subject controls block with immutable TargetRoot and PackageRoot.
Fresh V3 G03 Phase 9 and V4 clean results agree at the scoped pass/pre-ready checkpoint; Formal Pre/Diff and isolated package regression pass, while C6 and P10.2 remain separate.
